mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product(productId, prodName, brand, categoryId, inboundPrice, price, heelHeight, discRate, minGrade, status, regDate , thumbnail) VALUES (#{productId}, #{prodName}, #{brand}, #{categoryId}, #{inboundPrice}, #{price}, #{heelHeight}, #{discRate}, #{minGrade}, #{status}, SYSDATE, #{thumbnail})
INSERT INTO productImage(imageId, productId, files, sortOrder) VALUES (#{imageId}, #{productId}, #{files}, #{sortOrder})
